title_zh: 我不困，我不想睡觉-凯特格林纳威奖
title_en: I'm Not Tired, I Don't Want to Sleep
source_file: 我不困，我不想睡觉-凯特格林纳威奖（3-6岁）.pdf
full_text_zh:
[P1] WO BU KUN, WO BU XIANG SHUIJIAO
我不困, 我不想睡觉
[英] 罗伦·乔尔德 著 涂明求 译
接力出版社
Publishing House

[P2] 我有个妹妹叫劳拉。
她是个有趣的小人儿。
有时候我不得不看着她。
有时，爸爸妈妈要我想法儿哄她上床睡觉。
这任务可真够困难的，
因为劳拉喜欢熬到很晚才睡。

[P3] 劳拉总是到很晚还不睡，忙着——
涂颜色呀，
画画呀，
还有
剪剪贴贴呀，
还有
玩呼啦圈，
还有
玩皮球，
她最喜欢的就是
叽叽喳喳地
说个没完。

[P4] 通常，当我说：
“劳拉，妈妈说现在该上床睡觉了！”
她就会说：
“不嘛！我不困，
我
才不想
上床睡觉呢。”
我说：
“可是所有的小鸟儿
都已经去睡觉啦。”
劳拉会说：
“查理哥哥，
我又不是
一只小鸟儿。”

[P5] “可是，你肯定也该有点儿犯困了，劳拉！”我说。
“我一点儿也不困，
不管是 6 点、
7 点，
还是 8 点，
就是到了 9 点，
我还很清醒呢。
我一点儿都不累。
不管是 10 点、
11 点，
还是 12 点，
我想就是到了
13 点，
我都还挺精神呢。”
劳拉说
她
从来都不感觉
累。

[P6] “可是查理哥哥，”劳拉说，“要是我有草莓牛奶喝，
老虎也会想要草莓牛奶喝呀。”
“老虎?!”我问，“什么老虎?”
“就是桌子旁边的那些老虎呀！查理哥哥，
他们正在等着喝他们的睡前牛奶呢。
要是让他们等的时间太长的话，他们准会发脾气的。”
一天晚上，我说：
“可是如果不睡觉的话，你就不会有
睡前牛奶喝了，今晚它可是草莓牛奶
哟。”（劳拉很喜欢
喝草莓牛奶。）
我又问：
“你真的不想上
床睡觉吗？”

[P7] 然后，我对她说：
“我们去刷牙吧！”
可是劳拉说：“查理哥哥，我没办法刷牙啊，
因为有人正在吃我的牙刷。”
“谁会吃你的牙刷呢？”我问。
劳拉说：“我想是那只狮子吧，我看见他用我的
牙刷刷牙，现在他要把牙刷整个儿给吞下去了。”
“可是这把牙刷看起来才像你的呢，劳拉。”我说。
“噢，”劳拉说，
“那他一定是在用你的牙刷呢。”

[P8] 于是劳拉和那只狮子
一起刷牙。

[P9] 然后我说：“你得洗个澡啦。
你看起来有点儿脏呀。”
“谁说我脏的？”劳拉问。
“妈妈说的，”我答道，
“她一分钟后就会过来检查的。”
你猜猜劳拉怎么说？
“可是查理哥哥，我没办法洗澡啊，因为那儿
有鲸鱼。”
“鲸鱼？！
在哪儿？”
我一边说，
一边朝四下看。
“就是在浴缸里游泳的那些鲸鱼啊，
他们把整个空间都占满了。”她说。
“那你想要我做什么？”我问。
“也许你能帮我把其中的
一只鲸鱼从排水孔赶走。”劳拉说。
于是我帮劳拉把一只鲸鱼赶进了排水孔。

[P10] 然后
劳拉
才
跳进
浴缸。

[P11] “好了，劳拉，”我说，“你的睡衣在哪儿？”
“我没有什么睡衣呀，查理哥哥。”她说。
我说：“你枕头下放的是什么？”
“那不是我的睡衣。”劳拉摇着头说，
“哦，不，那睡衣是两只跳舞狗的。”
“那么，你想他们会把睡衣借给你穿吗？”
我问。
“也许会吧。”劳拉说，
“可是你得去给他们
打电话。”

[P12] 于是，我就给那两只跳舞狗打电话。——————————→“他们说什么？”劳拉问。

“他们说那睡衣你穿比他们更合适。
只要你喜欢，你什么时候都可以穿。”——————————→“他们可真好啊！”她说。

[P13] 这样，
劳拉才穿上了
她的睡衣。

[P14] 最后，
劳拉终于准备上床睡觉了。
我说：“好了，劳拉，
我已经给三只老虎
喝了睡前牛奶，
看着那只狮子
吞掉了我的牙刷，
还把一只
鲸鱼
赶进了排水孔，
也给
两只
跳舞狗
打了电话借来了睡衣。
现在
请
你
跳上
你的床，
好吗？
劳拉说：
“好的，好的，
查理哥哥，
我正在跳呢，
在跳呢……”

[P15] “可是查理哥哥……”
劳拉又说道。
“噢，不用说了。”我说，
“我知道，我能猜得到，
在你的床上
有一只巨大的河马。”
你知道
劳拉
说什么吗？
“别傻啦，
查理哥哥，
我才不会让河马睡在
我的床上呢。”

[P16] “可是，我想你的床上却有一只河马哟！”劳拉一边说着，
一边爬上了床。
“晚安，查理哥哥！
晚安，河马！”
“晚安，劳拉！”
full_text_en:
[P1] WO BU KUN, WO BU XIANG SHUIJIAO
I'm not tired, I don't want to sleep
[UK] Lauren Child, Author; Tu Mingqiu, Translator
Jieti Publishing House
Publishing House

[P2] I have a little sister named Laura.
She's a fun little girl.
Sometimes I have to watch her.
Sometimes, Mom and Dad ask me to think of ways to get her to bed.
This job is really tough,
because Laura likes to stay up late.

[P3] Lola always stays up late, busy with—
Coloring,
Drawing,
And
Cutting and pasting,
And
Playing with a hula hoop,
And
Playing with a ball,
Her favorite thing is
Chattering
Nonstop.

[P4] Usually, when I say:
"Laura, Mom says it's time to go to bed!"
She will say:
"No way! I'm not tired,
I
just don't want
to go to bed."
I say:
"But all the little birds
have already gone to sleep."
Laura will say:
"Charlie, big brother,
I'm not
a little bird."

[P5] "But you must be getting a little sleepy by now, Laura!" I said.
"I'm not sleepy at all,
whether it's 6 o'clock,
7 o'clock,
or 8 o'clock.
Even at 9 o'clock,
I'm still wide awake.
I'm not tired at all.
Whether it's 10 o'clock,
11 o'clock,
or 12 o'clock,
I think even at
13 o'clock,
I'm still feeling energetic!"
Laura said
she
never feels
tired.

[P6] "But Charlie," Laura said, "if I had strawberry milk, the tigers would want strawberry milk too." 
"Tigers?!" I asked. "What tigers?" 
"The ones by the table! Charlie, they're waiting for their bedtime milk. If we make them wait too long, they'll get grumpy." 
One evening, I said: 
"But if you don't go to sleep, you won't get your bedtime milk—tonight it's strawberry milk, you know." (Laura loves strawberry milk.) 
I asked again: 
"You really don't want to go to bed?"

[P7] Then, I said to her:
"Let's go brush our teeth!"
But Laura said, "Charlie, I can't brush my teeth,
because someone is eating my toothbrush."
"Who would eat your toothbrush?" I asked.
Laura said, "I think it's that lion. I saw him using my
toothbrush to brush his teeth, and now he's going to swallow it whole."
"But this toothbrush looks more like yours, Laura," I said.
"Oh," Laura said,
"Then he must be using your toothbrush."

[P8] So Laura and that lion
brushed their teeth together.

[P9] Then I said, “You need to take a bath.
You look a bit dirty.”
“Who said I’m dirty?” Laura asked.
“Mom said so,” I replied,
“She’ll be checking in one minute.”
Guess what Laura said?
“But Charlie, I can’t take a bath, because there are
whales in there.”
“Whales?! Where?”
I said,
while looking around.
“They’re the whales swimming in the bathtub,
they’ve taken up the whole space,” she said.
“What do you want me to do?” I asked.
“Maybe you could help me push one of the
whales down the drain,” Laura said.
So I helped Laura push a whale down the drain.

[P10] Then
Laura
finally
jumped into
the bathtub.

[P11] "Alright, Laura," I said, "where's your pajamas?"
"I don't have any pajamas, Charlie," she said.
I said, "What's under your pillow?"
"That's not my pajamas," Laura said, shaking her head,
"Oh, no, those pajamas are for two dancing dogs."
"So, do you think they'd lend them to you?"
I asked.
"Maybe," Laura said,
"But you'd have to call them
first."

[P12] So, I called those two dancing dogs. ————————→ “What did they say?” Laura asked.

“They said that pajamas fit you better than them.
You can wear them anytime you like.” ————————→ “They’re so nice!” she said.

[P13] This way,
Laura finally put on
her pajamas.

[P14] Finally,
Laura was ready to go to bed.
I said: "Alright, Laura,
I've given three tigers
their bedtime milk,
watched that lion
swallow my toothbrush,
and even sent a whale
down the drain,
and I called two
dancing dogs
to borrow your pajamas.
Now
please
jump
onto your bed,
okay?
Laura said:
"Okay, okay,
Charlie,
I'm jumping,
jumping..."

[P15] "But Charlie..." 
Lola said again.
"Oh, don't bother," I said, 
"I know, I can guess—
on your bed
there's a huge hippo." 
Do you know
what Lola
is saying?
"Don't be silly,
Charlie,
I wouldn't let a hippo sleep
on my bed!"

[P16] "But I think there's a hippo on your bed!" Laura said, climbing onto the bed.
"Goodnight, Charlie! Goodnight, hippo!"
"Goodnight, Laura!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《我不困，我不想睡觉》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者和出版社信息，背景为蓝色，中央有一套印有卡通图案的黄色儿童睡衣。
[P2] 本页介绍了主角有一个叫劳拉的妹妹，她很有趣但喜欢熬夜，因此哥哥/姐姐有时需要帮忙哄她睡觉，这是一项困难的任务。画面中，劳拉躺在床上玩玩具，而哥哥/姐姐站在床边，表情无奈。
[P3] 本页展示了劳拉在睡觉前的各种活动，包括涂颜色、画画、剪贴、玩呼啦圈和玩皮球，她最喜欢的就是叽叽喳喳地说个没完。
[P4] 本页描绘了哥哥查理试图哄妹妹劳拉睡觉的场景。劳拉坐在树上的鸟巢里，拒绝上床睡觉，她辩称自己不是小鸟，因此不需要像小鸟一样睡觉，而查理则用小鸟都睡觉了来劝说她。
[P5] 哥哥/姐姐试图说服妹妹劳拉睡觉，但劳拉坚持说自己从不困，无论时间多晚都精神饱满，甚至声称到13点也依然清醒。
[P6] 哥哥查理试图用草莓牛奶哄妹妹劳拉睡觉，但劳拉却编造出桌子旁有老虎在等牛奶的借口，继续拖延睡觉时间。
[P7] 哥哥查理试图让妹妹劳拉刷牙，但劳拉编造出狮子正在吃她的牙刷的借口来拖延，查理则幽默地指出牙刷更像他的，劳拉便改口说狮子在用哥哥的牙刷。
[P8] 劳拉和她想象中的狮子一起刷牙，画面中劳拉拿着牙刷，狮子也拿着牙刷，两人并排站立，背景是粉色花纹墙纸和木质地板。
[P9] 哥哥查理让妹妹劳拉洗澡，劳拉以浴缸里有鲸鱼为借口拒绝，查理配合她假装把鲸鱼赶进排水孔，继续哄她睡觉。
[P10] 劳拉在哥哥查理哄骗下，终于跳进浴缸洗澡，浴缸里有一只想象中的鲸鱼。
[P11] 哥哥查理拿着劳拉的睡衣问她在哪里，劳拉拒绝穿，称睡衣是两只跳舞狗的，并要求查理去给狗打电话才能借来穿。
[P12] 哥哥查理假装给劳拉想象中的跳舞狗打电话，说睡衣更适合她，劳拉听后高兴地接受了睡衣。
[P13] 劳拉在哥哥查理的哄骗下，终于穿上了睡衣，画面中她站在床边，旁边有两只想象中的跳舞狗在跳舞，房间内散落着玩具和书籍。
[P14] 哥哥查理通过想象中的老虎、狮子、鲸鱼和跳舞狗，哄妹妹劳拉穿好睡衣，准备上床睡觉，劳拉则回应说正在跳床。
[P15] 劳拉拒绝上床睡觉，声称床上有河马，哥哥查理假装猜到她的借口，劳拉则反驳说不会让河马睡在她的床上。
[P16] 劳拉以床上有河马为借口拒绝睡觉，但最终爬上床并假装与河马道晚安，哥哥查理也回应她，画面右侧显示劳拉已入睡。
